placeResult.name: Astrid & Gastón
placeResult.description: Peruvian restaurant where creativity, quality, integration and commitment converge. Tasting menu is only served from 13:00 to 14:30 and from 19:00 to 22:30
placeResult.neighborhood_description: San Isidro brims with a refined elegance, a neighborhood in Lima that is synonymous with sophistication. As the financial center of the city, it boasts an impressive skyline but is equally renowned for its green spaces, such as Olivar Park, a quiet haven of olive trees that date back to the 16th century. The culinary scene is equally enticing, with a plethora of gourmet restaurants offering a unique fusion of traditional Peruvian and international cuisine. Architectural marvels abound, such as the Huaca Huallamarca pyramid, offering a glimpse of pre-Inca times. For commuting, the Metropolitano bus system offers efficient transit across the city.
placeResult.reviews_summary: Astrid & Gastón is celebrated by many travelers for its elegant and artistically decorated atmosphere, creating a sophisticated yet cozy dining experience. The Peruvian cuisine, known for its creative and beautifully presented dishes, earns high praise from guests, although some find certain dishes lacking in flavor. Service is frequently noted as attentive and friendly, though occasional lapses occur during busy periods. While the restaurant is seen as offering reasonable value by many, some warn of high prices and mixed experiences with wait times.
